name: Account Map
description: Org-chart canvas for account planning, backed by a Frame database and server functions.

functions.name: create-map
functions.description: Create a new account map and return its snapshot.

functions.name: delete-contact
functions.description: Delete a contact from an account map, along with any edges attached to it.

functions.name: delete-edge
functions.description: Delete an edge between two contacts.

functions.name: delete-note
functions.description: Delete a sticky note from an account map.

functions.name: delete-role
functions.description: Delete a deal role. Contacts assigned to it fall back to 'No Role Assigned'. Returns the full roles list.

functions.name: dismiss-blind-spot
functions.description: Dismiss a blind spot, or restore a dismissed one. A dismissed spot stays out of the map and is not revived by a later scan.

functions.name: get-map
functions.description: Return the full snapshot of an account map (maps list, roles, contacts, edges, sticky notes). Omit mapId for the first active map.

functions.name: import-map
functions.description: Create a map from imported data (JSON export, CSV rows, or agent-built org data). Contacts use a client-side 'ref' key to wire edges. Role is matched by roleName (case-insensitive). Set mapId to import into an existing map instead of creating one.

functions.name: move-items
functions.description: Batch-save canvas positions for contacts, sticky notes and blind-spot ghost cards after dragging.

functions.name: next-best-actions
functions.description: Return the ranked next-best-action queue for an account map: warm introductions into blind spots, relationships going cold, untouched committee seats, expansion signals, renewal exposure and map hygiene. Each action carries the agent prompt that would do

functions.name: resolve-blind-spot
functions.description: Promote a blind spot's suggested person into a real contact on the map, at the ghost card's position, wired to its anchor contact when it has one. Marks the blind spot resolved and returns the refreshed snapshot.

functions.name: save-contact
functions.description: Create or update a contact card on an account map. Pass id to update; omit to create.

functions.name: save-edge
functions.description: Create a reporting ('default') or 'influence' edge between two contacts on a map. Duplicate source/target pairs are reused.

functions.name: save-note
functions.description: Create or update a sticky note on an account map. Pass id to update; omit to create.

functions.name: save-role
functions.description: Create or update a deal role (name + color). Returns the full roles list.

functions.name: scan-blind-spots
functions.description: Scan an account map for blind spots: buying-committee seats nobody fills, company functions with no contact, leaders whose org is unmapped, and relationships that have gone quiet. Ghost cards get a suggested person and a warm introduction path. Re-running

functions.name: send-agent-task
functions.description: Start a Dust agent task in a new account-map conversation, optionally scoped to one contact.

functions.name: update-action
functions.description: Mark a next-best-action as done, snoozed, or open again, and optionally record the agent conversation opened for it. Upserts on the action key, so repeating the call is safe.

functions.name: update-map
functions.description: Rename, trash, restore, or permanently destroy an account map. Returns the updated maps list.
